    • getMenx

      public List<Menx> getMenx()
      Gets the value of the menx property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the menx property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getMenx().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list Menx
